response.query: What controlled multivariate simulation designs (varying coherence, rank, sparsity, and SNR) will we use to benchmark Ledoit–Wolf versus low-rank+sparse cross-spectral regularization, and how will we compute FDR and power using block-permutation tests?
response.answer: We will use controlled multivariate simulations varying coherence, rank, sparsity, and SNR to benchmark Ledoit–Wolf versus low-rank+sparse cross-spectral regularization. FDR and power will be computed using block-permutation tests.
